purpose: yara-python native match timeout that C passes to the Cisco SDK 4.8.6 YaraAnalyzer rules (the SDK calls match without a timeout)
rule: rule slow: one-byte string, nested for-loops over every match offset (quadratic in match count)
notes: 64 KB is the scanner's per-definition limit (DEFAULT_MAX_DEFINITION_BYTES). Without a timeout the 64 KB case does not finish in practice; the bundled SDK rules finish well under the limit on normal definitions.
